subject: Request: Limited release checklist for penetration test report + NDA clarifications
messages:
From: Tom Wu <tom.wu@acme-analytics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security-legal@acme-analytics.com
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pen test report access + SOC2/CAIQ evidence request

Jonas,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. Our compliance team is finalizing the vendor risk review for the Acme ingestion pipeline and they requested the most recent penetration test report for Redwood Inference (last 12 months) and a short executive summary that we can attach to our SIG/CAIQ evidence packet.

Two asks from legal/compliance:
- Can we get the unredacted exec summary and (ideally) the full report under an NDA?
- If you cannot provide the full report, what is your redaction approach and can you provide a redaction checklist so our auditors understand what is withheld?

Please also include what remediation evidence you can provide for high/critical findings (tickets, remediation dates). We need this by 2027-09-24 to keep our review on schedule.

If there are standard constraints (e.g., third-party tester restrictions) let us know and we can escalate internally.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a short call if easier.

Tom Wu
Head of Security Operations
Acme Analytics

[External Attachment: Acme-Vendor-Risk-Checklist.xlsx (attachment stub)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Wu <tom.wu@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Kim Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report access + SOC2/CAIQ evidence request

Tom — thanks for the clear asks. We're committed to supporting Acme's review; a few important constraints up front:

- Our third-party pen test vendor requires an NDA with a specific non-disclosure clause before we can share the full report.
- For customer reviews we typically provide: (1) a redacted executive summary (PDF) by default, (2) a redaction matrix describing withheld items, and (3) timebound access to the full report via our secure viewer for named recipients only.

Proposed path (fastest to meet your 9/24 timeline):
1) We send a redacted exec summary and a redaction checklist today. (Attached: exec-summary-redacted.pdf, redaction-checklist.csv)
2) If you require the full report, legal signs our mutual NDA (attached MUTUAL-NDA-v3.docx) or we can accept a redline. After NDA executes, we grant secure-viewer access (watermarked, no-download by default) to your two reviewers for 48 hours.
3) For remediation evidence on high/critical findings, we can share ticket IDs + remediation dates and test re-runs for verified fixes.

Questions for you: who will be the two named reviewers (full names + emails) for secure-viewer access? Also, is Acme comfortable with a watermarked PDF-only view, or do you need a downloadable copy under escrow?

I'll leave Rishi and Kim in copy — Rishi will own the remediation evidence, Kim is our legal contact for the NDA.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Director, Solutions & Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: exec-summary-redacted.pdf (redacted executive summary), redaction-checklist.csv (CSV with redaction rationale), MUTUAL-NDA-v3.docx (draft)]

From: Alice Ramsey <alice.ramsey@cloudcap.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@acme-analytics.com>, security-legal@acme-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report access + SOC2/CAIQ evidence request

Jonas — CloudCap (our integrator) is supporting Acme's review and I can be one of the two named reviewers. My details: Alice Ramsey, alice.ramsey@cloudcap.io.

A couple of quick clarifications from Acme legal:
- They prefer a signed mutual NDA before any part of the full report is exposed.
- Watermarked view is acceptable for initial review; if the legal team requires a copy for evidence retention, they may request a downloadable copy under escrow (with audit logs).

Tom, can you confirm if security-legal will sign Redwood's MUTUAL-NDA-v3 as-is or will you propose edits? We can turn this around quickly.

Thanks,
Alice
Senior Solutions Engineer
CloudCap Integrations

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Wu <tom.wu@acme-analytics.com>, Alice Ramsey <alice.ramsey@cloudcap.io>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kim Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 11:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report access + SOC2/CAIQ evidence request

Tom/Alice — looping in remediation details. Summary and timeline below:

Redaction approach (high level):
- We redact attacker-supplied PII, full exploit payloads that reveal PoC code, and customer-identifying URLs. We do NOT redact vulnerability categories, impacted components, CVE references, or remediation descriptions.

What we can provide now:
- Redacted exec summary (already attached by Jonas)
- Redaction checklist explaining each redaction (attached CSV)
- Ticket references for high/critical items: RW-1998 (fixed 2027-07-18), RW-2042 (mitigated 2027-08-02, verification 2027-09-10), RW-2176 (in-progress, ETA 2027-09-30).

If NDA signed:
- We will grant secure-viewer access to Alice and the two Acme reviewers for a 48-hour window. Viewer features: watermarked with reviewer email, download disabled by default, print disabled, IP and access logs retained for audit.
- If Acme requires a downloadable copy, Redwood can place the full report into a secure escrow with audit logging; this requires a short addendum to the mutual NDA (we've attached suggested language).

Action items for Acme to proceed:
- Supply full names and emails of the two reviewers (Alice confirmed one).
- Legal to confirm NDA or send redlines to kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com.
- Confirm whether a downloadable escrow copy will be required (so we can prepare the addendum).

I can also run a short 20-min walkthrough of the redaction checklist and remediation ticket evidence if helpful.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Product Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

[Attachment referenced: secure-viewer-instructions.txt]

From: Tom Wu <tom.wu@acme-analytics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Alice Ramsey <alice.ramsey@cloudcap.io>
Cc: security-legal@acme-analytics.com
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report access + SOC2/CAIQ evidence request

Team — thank you. Acme legal will sign Redwood's MUTUAL-NDA-v3 with one small edit to the sub-processor clause; they sent redlines to kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com earlier today.

Reviewers: Alice Ramsey (alice.ramsey@cloudcap.io), Michael Chen (michael.chen@acme-analytics.com). Please provision secure-viewer access to those two once NDA is countersigned.

On escrow: legal will accept a watermarked viewer for the moment. They may request an escrowed downloadable copy after initial review; we will notify you if that is required.

Next steps we need from Redwood:
- Confirmation you received legal redlines and an ETA for countersignature.
- Secure-viewer link + short instructions after NDA executes.
- List of remediation ticket references (Rishi provided these, thanks) — we will map those to our internal risk tracker.

I'll watch for the DocuSign link; please copy security-legal@acme-analytics.com on the execution.

Tom Wu
Head of Security Operations
Acme Analytics

[Attachment received: Acme-Redlines-MUTUAL-NDA.docx (attachment stub)]
